body: Projects directory (search, open/in-progress counts, last update, folder, add by path, remove from list with confirmation, missing projects marked); top bar with Projects, project breadcrumb, search and Create; project sidebar (Summary, Board, List, Documents, Design, refresh, folder). Jira-like tokens, typography, lozenges, type and priority icons, avatars. URLs ?project=KEY&view=…&ticket=KEY-n. Summary with stat cards, status/priority/type breakdowns and 'Ready to start' from pman next (/api/next). Verified in Chromium desktop and iPhone 13.
author: claude
